name: dc-el_alamein-coop-lod0-rec
description: dc-el_alamein-coop-rec with the bots' level of detail switched off: `aiSettings.lodEnable 0` (AIDefault.con turns it on; with it off, `AILODManager::updateBots` 0x08475f00 sets each bot to LOD 0 in turn instead of from its distance to a human). With no human every bot is otherwise at AI LOD 2, where the AI moves a land hull and fires fake (AI-136, AI-134). This is the bots-only round whose land hulls are driven by the physics. Needs `lab.py setup --mods-from-client DesertCombat`.
human: No client needed: the server records itself. Check the recorder's `lod` records read 0 after the round starts; then let it play and `lab.py stop`.
